title: Advertisement Services Districtwide

onscreen_lines.desc: Percent Discount on Digital Advertising via the internet, including but not limited to: Google ads, social media sites, and pop-up advertisements. DISCOUNT LINE In the case of line items awarded on the basis of discounts from Offeror’s, to include but not limited to website, catalog, jobber’s or manufacturer’s price list, an informal (telephone or written) price quote may be requested, for items contained within the general line item category. The District may purchase the best value item using any contracts made pursuant to an award under this solicitation, whether in a form of a signed written agreement, a purchase order, these ST&Cs, or otherwise (each, a "Contract") with the awarded Offeror who enters into the Contract (each, a "Vendor") as the basis for that purchase. Offeror quote, if applicable, and invoice will reflect the original price, the percent discount, and the final cost to the District. Line items left blank will be considered zero (0) percent.
